meta.title: The Hospital Game
meta.textType: story: a chant with repeated lines

paragraphs: On Saturday afternoon, Lily, Mia, and Leo played in the garden. They played a hospital game. Lily and Mia put on white shirts and paper hats, and they were nurses. Leo was a sick man on a blue blanket. He had a long black paper beard and a mustache. Leo closed his eyes and held his head. "I'm very sick," he said. "I have a headache." Pip sat next to the blanket and watched.

"Nurse, nurse!" called Leo. "Come here, please!" Lily and Mia ran to him. "Don't worry," said Lily. "We are here to help you." "Let's say a chant," said Mia. "Headache, headache, say goodbye!" "Nurse is here, nurse is here!" "Headache, headache, say goodbye!" They said it again and again, and Leo laughed.

Then Pip took the paper mustache from Leo's face. He ran around the garden with it. "Come back, Pip!" shouted Leo. Mom watched them from the kitchen window. Then she came to the door. "What are you doing?" she asked. "We're at the hospital," said Mia. "Leo is sick, and we are the nurses." Mom smiled and said, "I'm a nurse at a big hospital." "A good nurse always washes her hands." The girls washed their hands with water. "Are you all right now, Leo?" asked Lily. "Yes, thank you, doctor!" said Leo. Pip came back with the mustache on his nose. It looked very funny. Everyone laughed.
